description_en: Queries the information about a deployment package
description_zh: 调用GetDeployment获取发布包的详情
name: GetDeployment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the Workspace Manage icon in the upper-right corner of the DataStudio page to go to the Workspace Management page and view the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The GUID of the DataWorks workspace. You can view the GUID in the upper part of the DataStudio page. You can also select another GUID to switch to another workspace.

You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. A deployment task ID is generated when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 发布包的ID。执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173944.html 和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173956.html时，都会生成一个对应的发布包ID
parameters.name: deployment_id

Data.description_en: The details of the deployment package

items.description_en: The details of the deployed item

Status.description_en:
UNPUBLISHED(0): not published
SUCCESS(1): Published
ERROR(2): Publishing failed
CLONED(3): successfully CLONED
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): Publishing failed
CLONING(5): CLONING
REJECT(6): release rejected
Status.description_zh:
UNPUBLISHED(0): 未发布
SUCCESS(1): 发布成功
ERROR(2): 发布失败
CLONED(3): 克隆成功
DEPLOY_ERROR(4): 发布失败
CLONING(5): 克隆中
REJECT(6): 发布驳回

Deployment.description_en: The details of the deployment package

CheckingStatus.description_en:
The check status of one or more files in the deployment task. If the value of the ToEnvironment parameter is 1, the files can be deployed to the production environment only when the value of the Status parameter is 1 and the CheckingStatus parameter is empty. Valid values:

7: The file failed the check.
8: The file is being checked
CheckingStatus.description_zh:
当前发布包涉及节点的检查状态，当发布包的目标环境是开发环境（toEnviroment=1）时，只有发布包的Status为1并且CheckingStatus为空时，才可以继续进行文件到生产环境的发布。
7：检查未通过
8：正在处于检查中的状态

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the deployment task was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 发布包生成的毫秒时间戳

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who created the deployment task
CreatorId.description_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that was returned when the deployment package failed. In this case, the value of the Status parameter is 2
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 当发布包执行失败（status为2）后，该字段记录具体的错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The time when the deployment task was run. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
ExecuteTime.description_zh: 发布包开始执行的毫秒时间戳

FromEnvironment.description_en: The environment in which the deployment task was run. Valid values: 0 and 1. A value of 0 indicates the on-premises environment. A value of 1 indicates the development environment
FromEnvironment.description_zh: 执行本次发布所在的环境，包括0（本地）和1（开发环境）

HandlerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who ran the deployment task
HandlerId.description_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment task. The value is the same as the name of the specific deployment task that is displayed on the Release Package page in the Deploy module
Name.description_zh: 发布包的名称，显示在任务发布>发布包列表页面

Status.description_en: The status of the deployment task. Valid values: 0, 1, and 2. A value of 0 indicates that the task is ready. A value of 1 indicates that the task was successful. A value of 2 indicates that the task failed
Status.description_zh: 发布包当前的状态，包括0（就绪）、1（成功）和2（失败）

ToEnvironment.description_en: The environment to which the file was deployed. Valid values: 1 and 2. A value of 1 indicates the development environment. A value of 2 indicates the production environment
ToEnvironment.description_zh: 发布文件信息的目标环境，包括1（开发环境）和2（生产环境）

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can troubleshoot errors based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
